set: B: one sheet of each acting state the page uses, plain, nervous, shocked, scared, confident, angry and exhausted, with no time and no word on it

issues.where: first orange flash through the following two rows
issues.what: The tip changes color and smokes, but the held arrow silhouette barely changes. The effect is legible; a shock, pain, or decision to press on is not.
issues.fix: Compress the point and pull the body back on the flash, hold a visibly buckled pose, then let it recover its aim while still smoking.

issues.where: last five frames as it reaches the burnt button
issues.what: The limp shape sells damage, but contact is mostly a glide into overlap. There is no clear loaded push or release to tell a deliberate press from drifting against the edge.
issues.fix: Set the point visibly on the edge, bow the tail against the resistance, and release the bend after the push.

issues.where: rows two and three, during the subdued hold
issues.what: The collapsed silhouette is visible early, but most of the hold is a near-neutral arrow with little change in stance, so the feeling fades into idle hovering.
issues.fix: Hold the low, curled silhouette longer and make the lift into the final upright pose one distinct recovery.

issues.where: rightward aim from the end of row one to the end of the sheet
issues.what: The turn and aim are clear, but the bright releases mostly animate without the body. The sustained pose reads as a fixed pointer while the flashes do the work.
issues.fix: Draw back into a loaded point just before the first release and punctuate the streaks with a small recoil and re-aim.

issues.where: first two rows after the opening flash
issues.what: The arrow holds a nearly ordinary pointer silhouette for several frames. The shadow change suggests motion, but the body gives little away about its reaction or intent until the dart.
issues.fix: Give the arrival a visible settling bend, then hold a tentative lean toward the panel before releasing into the dart.

issues.what: did not read: scared reads as deflated and uncertain: hanging back, a slump flat, a slow pull upright. Pale and stony, the lean back and the hiding behind the nearest field are not in the read.
issues.fix: Scared as the kit has it: the arrow gone pale and stiff, leaning back, behind the nearest field, held long enough to be seen.

issues.what: did not read: angry reads as rigid and intent, almost unfazed: the orange tip and the smoke are seen and the body says nothing with them.
issues.fix: Anger in the body before the heat: squared up to the machine, a held lean in, and then the red tip and the steam.

reads.read: Wary curiosity: it emerges from a flash, hovers, then perks up and darts toward the verification panel.
Tempted but nervous: it noses toward the empty ‘I am not a robot’ checkbox, flinches away, and leaves it unchecked.
Startled and rattled: the Submit button tears loose amid cracks and debris, and the arrow jerks back and wobbles.
Deflated and uncertain: it hangs back, slumps flat for a moment, then slowly pulls itself upright.
Suddenly focused and defiant: it whips around, takes aim to the right, and appears to fire little bright streaks from its point.
Rigid and intent, almost unfazed: its tip flashes orange and starts smoking, but it keeps facing right as more bright streaks pass along the same line.
Battered and reluctant but trying anyway: its blackened tip droops, then it edges back in and leans into the scorched Submit button.
